description: Defines the SubunitTreeModel class which constructs a hierarchical tree structure from a collection of Subunit objects, used for representing organizational subunits in a tree format.

classes.name: SubunitTreeModel
classes.description: A model that converts a list of Subunit entities into a nested tree structure suitable for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an array of Subunit objects.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the subunit collection into a hierarchical tree array.

methods.name: toTree
methods.description: Recursively builds a nested tree structure from a flat collection of Subunit objects based on their levels.
